example_sentences_in_bangla: তারা গা ঘেঁষা করে বসে গল্প করছিল।
বাসে যাত্রীরা গা ঘেঁষা করে বসতে বাধ্য হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: They were sitting cheek by jowl, chatting away.
Passengers in the bus had to sit very close together.
note: This idiom reflects everyday physical closeness in crowded or informal Bengali settings.
